messages.author: 8c42220cee01de86
messages.subject: How to install "INLAspacetime" on HPC
parts:
Hello: there

Is there any way to install "INLAspacetime" on HPC?

Kind regards

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How to install "INLAspacetime" on HPC
parts:
Hi,
Can you provide some more details of some problem you’re having? The package itself is on CRAN, so should install like any other R package. The c-code is compiled into the inla package itself as well, so should be ok as long as inla itself is installed.
Finn

On 18 Jan 2024, at 05:25, afsc sf <sfaf...@gmail.com> wrote:

﻿Hello: there

Kind regards
